tools.title: Marketing
tools.subtitle: Manage your shop visibility, conversations, and brand profile

cue.title: Add fresh catalog photos
cue.body: New photos give your reels, posts and Google updates more to work with.

website.title: Website Studio
website.body: Draft, edit and publish your site

inbox.emptyBody: Connect Instagram or Facebook to see customer messages here and answer them with AI drafts you check before sending.
inbox.emptyFootnote: Messages show up here once an account is connected.
inbox.lockNote: Connect an account to receive messages.
inbox.noConversations: No messages yet. New Instagram and Messenger conversations show up here.

reply.title: Reply assistant
reply.approvalBody: No message is ever sent without your explicit click.

reviews.emptyBody: Connect your Google Business Profile to see your Google reviews and reply to them.
reviews.automatedBody: Once your Google Business Profile is connected and verified, you get a link to send customers.
reviews.connectedEmptyBody: New Google reviews will show up here for you to reply to.
reviews.linkBody: Send customers this link after a visit or purchase. It opens Google's review form for your business.

people.emptyBody: People you hear from through connected customer channels will appear here.
people.directoryBody: Open a person’s record to see their conversations and contact details in one place.

google.presenceBody: Keep your business visible on Google Maps and Search.
google.profileBody: Reply to your Google reviews and post updates to Google Search and Maps.

catalog.title: Profile & catalog updates
catalog.body: Post updates with your product photos to your Google profile.

reviews.title: Review link
reviews.body: Share your Google review link with customers after a visit or purchase.

replies.title: Reply drafts
replies.body: Espanda drafts a reply to each review. You edit it and post it yourself.

google.controlBody: Nothing is posted or replied to on Google until you approve it.
google.connectNote: You can disconnect any time in Business → Connections.

googleWorkspace.subtitle: Post updates and keep your profile complete on Google Search and Maps.
googleWorkspace.reviewsBody: Reviews and reply drafts are collected with your customer conversations.
googleWorkspace.noPostsBody: Tap New Google post to draft one from your photos. Nothing is posted until you publish it.
googleWorkspace.posted: Sent to Google. It can take a few minutes to appear.
googleWorkspace.unverifiedTitle: Google hasn't verified this business yet
googleWorkspace.unverifiedBody: Posts and the review link only work once Google verifies your business. Verify it in Google Business Profile.

website.footnote: Review your content and domain before publishing.

websitePublish.footnote: Verify a domain and review the content to publish.
websitePublish.title: Review your website
websitePublish.subtitle: Check your content and destination before going live.
websitePublish.destinationBody: Connect and verify a domain to publish this draft.
